dialogues.speaker: Ishikawa
dialogues.text: Hmm? A traveler like you shouldn't be in a place like this. Are you lost?

dialogues.speaker: Ishikawa
dialogues.text: Oh, I'm just an ordinary new recruit who never wanted to go to war or join the military. However, I was born into a samurai family, so the choice wasn't mine to make. It's my duty to join the military and go to war for the sake of my family's honor.

dialogues.speaker: Ishikawa
dialogues.text: What's annoying is that this war keeps dragging on... The battlefield is not like training... It's a place of life or death.

dialogues.speaker: Ishikawa
dialogues.text: See you. I really hope this war ends soon...

dialogues.speaker: Ishikawa
dialogues.text: Hmm? A traveler like you shouldn't be in a place like this. Are you lost?

dialogues.speaker: Ishikawa
dialogues.text: Oh, I'm just an ordinary new recruit who never wanted to go to war or join the military. Due to my family background, however, the choice wasn't mine to make.

dialogues.speaker: Ishikawa
dialogues.text: Well, at least the Shogunate and Sangonomiya have agreed to a ceasefire, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Ishikawa
dialogues.text: I mean, war isn't like training. It's real swords and spears that are clashing out there.

dialogues.speaker: Ishikawa
dialogues.text: This might seem like a joke, but despite my samurai status, I get faint at the sight of blood. I nearly didn't make it off the battlefield several times.

dialogues.speaker: Ishikawa
dialogues.text: I can only hope that by the Electro Archon's grass, this ceasefire between the two sides will be a permanent one.

dialogues.speaker: Ishikawa
dialogues.text: Goodbye. Ah, would that this ceasefire would last a little longer...
